_doc.what: What a METHOD card is: one entry per translation engine or LLM provider, projected from shared/method-registry.json through the same facts→spec→projector chain as a language card.
_doc.why: Reading the registry directly in the website build would have been quicker, and is exactly how the language corpus acquired 93 scripts and no definition of what a card is. Going through the same machinery means a correction propagates the same way, absence behaves the same way, and there is ONE answer to 'where does this value come from' across all three card types.
rules: No measured score may appear here. chrF, BLEU and COMET are keyed by (method, dataset, metric) and are properties of a RUN, not of a method. Same boundary as the language card's lint R3.

A field with no entry in this spec is not projected. `unmodelled` facts exist in the store so a key added upstream cannot pass unnoticed, but they do not reach a card until someone gives them a place.
Absence omits. A method with no recorded cost shows no cost row, rather than an empty one.

id.meaning: Registry key — the name the CLI and harness both use.

kind.meaning: What sort of thing this is: an MT API, an LLM provider, or a local runtime.

paradigm.meaning: How it produces a translation — neural NMT, raw LLM, rule-based.
paradigm.note: The single most useful thing to know before reading any score against this method.

methodClass.meaning: The harness's own class for the method.

licensing.note: The constraint that actually gates use. An UNSTATED licence is not a permissive one — where the registry records none the field is absent, and absent must be read as 'unknown, therefore do not assume'.

commercialReady.note: A human's reading of the licence, recorded once so the CLI and the harness cannot answer it differently.

cost.meaning: What it costs to run, in the registry's own words.
cost.note: Kept as prose, never parsed into a number. '~$20 / 1M characters' and 'per-model token pricing (fetched at runtime)' are not the same kind of claim, and flattening them into one numeric field would invent a comparison neither supports.

runsLocally.note: A locally-run method sends no text to a third party, which is what makes it usable for sealed corpora and for any LicenseRef set awaiting a transmission-consent grant.
